clips.title: Dressing Down After Golden Week
grammar: 〜た時 — when / at the time of
やっぱり — as expected / after all

lines.ja: 4月にさ、みんなでさ、ご飯食べに行った時の写真出てきた。
lines.en: I found a photo from when we all went out to eat in April.
lines.speaker: Girl on Left

lines.ja: え、なんか前と服の系統変わった？
lines.en: Wait, did your clothing style change since before?
lines.speaker: Girl on Right

lines.ja: やっぱダル着が楽だよ。
lines.en: Comfy loungewear is just the easiest, honestly.
lines.speaker: Girl on Right
